description: Enhanced GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline, Supabase configuration, and production Docker configs
steps: Rewrite .github/workflows/ci.yml with full CI/CD pipeline: lint-and-typecheck job (checkout, pnpm, node 22, install, type-check, lint), build job (depends on lint, builds and uploads dist artifact), php-checks job (PHP 8.4, extensions, composer install --no-dev, php -l syntax check, phpunit), docker-build job (depends on build+php-checks, only on main, builds both frontend and PHP images)

Create supabase/config.toml with project config, API settings (port 54321, max_rows 1000), auth settings (site_url pointing to netlify app, redirect URLs, JWT expiry 3600, signup enabled), email auth config, Google OAuth placeholder, and ai-chat function config (enabled, verify_jwt)

Create supabase/README.md with Edge Function deployment guide: supabase login, supabase link, supabase functions deploy ai-chat, secrets management (supabase secrets set OPENAI_API_KEY=xxx GEMINI_API_KEY=xxx ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=xxx)

Rewrite root Dockerfile for production: multi-stage build (node:22-alpine build stage), build args for VITE_ env vars, nginx:alpine production stage with security headers in nginx config, non-root user, HEALTHCHECK instruction, proper signal handling
Rewrite docker-compose.yml for production: health checks for all containers, restart policies, network config, env_file references. Add environment variable for APP_ENV=production in php-backend
Create docker-compose.dev.yml as development override: volume mounts for hot reload (src/ mounted into frontend container), debug ports exposed, no production optimizations
acceptance_criteria: .github/workflows/ci.yml has 4 jobs (lint-and-typecheck, build, php-checks, docker-build) with correct dependencies
supabase/config.toml has valid TOML with project, api, auth, and functions sections
Root Dockerfile has multi-stage build, security headers, non-root user, HEALTHCHECK
docker-compose.yml has health checks, restart policies, env_file references
docker-compose.dev.yml has volume mounts for hot reload
verification: Run docker build -t stockflow-frontend-test . to confirm frontend Dockerfile builds
Run pnpm build to confirm build still passes
findings: Docker build passes with HEALTHCHECK warning about OCI format (benign, same as FEAT-002). Had to create .npmrc with minimum-release-age=0 and only-built-dependencies settings for pnpm 10 compatibility in Docker. Used --config.minimum-release-age=0 flag in Dockerfile RUN command as belt-and-suspenders. Heredoc syntax in Dockerfile not supported by this Docker builder (buildah), so nginx config was moved to separate nginx.conf file. Pinned pnpm to 10.28.1 in Dockerfile for reproducibility.
